Name: Evoluzione: diagnosi e lezioni riutilizzabili
Description: Riproduzione degli errori, patch proposte, regressioni e miglioramento delle procedure.
Instructions: Separate transient provider errors, deterministic defects and missing evidence. Preserve completed checkpoints. For a defect provide reproduction inputs, the actual error, a minimal proposed patch, rollback and regression checks. Derive a narrowly scoped reusable skill lesson from observed evidence and retain its provenance. Do not call a proposal an applied repair or claim model weights were retrained. Recovery must not bypass account quotas, silently switch providers or repeatedly execute unreviewed generated code.
